engine_defect_found: remotion-engine/public is 1.7GB and is copied into the bundle on every render, and public/edit_reel/mg is a dangling symlink to a missing target which aborts that copy with ENOENT. An empty --public-dir fails differently: sibling compositions load fonts at module scope and @remotion/fonts cancelRenders on a 404. Rendering works with --public-dir pointed at a directory containing only fonts/. The symlink was left in place: it is outside this ledger's OWNS.
